english.note: Use this when someone insists on doing something despite other people objecting or advising against it.

examples.english: I told them not to go, but they stubbornly insisted on going.
examples.traditional: 我叫佢唔好去，佢硬係要去。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 heoi3 keoi5 ngaang6 hai6 jiu3 heoi3
